_: How each installer is run silently in a fresh Wine prefix to record what it leaves behind (tools/snapshot/record.py). 'installer' names the asset on the system-libraries-v1 release; 'args' are the installer's own unattended switches; 'arch' is the Wine prefix (win64 unless the installer refuses one); 'timeout' seconds before the run is killed; 'dll_overrides' Wine overrides for the run itself (never recorded).

K-Lite.notes: Inno Setup 6.4. The pack registers its DirectShow filters (LAV, ffdshow, madVR...) with regsvr32 during setup; those CLSID / filter entries are the point of the recording.
